# The Fix Wizard

> Licensed and insured chimney repair, masonry, and handyman services across all 21 counties in New Jersey.

The Fix Wizard is a New Jersey home repair company specializing in two core services: Chimney & Masonry repair and general Handyman Services. We serve every county in NJ — from Bergen in the north to Cape May in the south. Same-day appointments available. Free estimates. Licensed and insured.

## Contact & Business Info

- Phone: (555) 123-4567
- Email: hello@handypro.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7am–7pm
- Service Area: All of New Jersey (21 counties)
- License: Licensed & insured in New Jersey

## Core Services

### Chimney & Masonry Repair in New Jersey
[Full page](https://thefixwizard.com/chimney-masonry-new-jersey/)

We provide professional chimney and masonry repair across New Jersey including:
- Chimney sweeping and annual inspection
- Tuckpointing and mortar repointing
- Chimney crown repair and replacement
- Chimney cap installation
- Chimney liner installation
- Chimney flashing repair and waterproofing
- Spalling brick repair and replacement
- Full and partial chimney rebuilds
- Firebox repair
- Exterior masonry, retaining walls, and steps
- Chimney draft repair
- Fireplace damper repair

Typical cost: $150–$800 for chimney sweeping and inspection; $500–$3,000 for tuckpointing; $1,000–$5,000+ for liner installation or rebuilds.

### Handyman Services in New Jersey
[Full page](https://thefixwizard.com/handyman-services-new-jersey/)

We handle a wide range of home repair and maintenance tasks including:
- Drywall repair, patching, and texture matching
- Interior and exterior painting
- Door repair and installation (interior and exterior)
- Furniture assembly (IKEA, Wayfair, Amazon)
- TV mounting and wall shelving installation
- Light electrical (outlets, switches, fixtures, ceiling fans, GFCI)
- Light plumbing (faucets, toilets, drains, disposals)
- Weatherstripping and door seals
- Caulking and sealing
- Tile repair and grout

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is The Fix Wizard licensed and insured in New Jersey?**
A: Yes. The Fix Wizard is fully licensed and insured in New Jersey for all services offered. We carry liability insurance on every job and all technicians are background-checked.

**Q: Do you offer same-day service?**
A: Yes. We offer same-day appointments across all 21 NJ counties. Call (555) 123-4567 for urgent requests.

**Q: Do you offer free estimates?**
A: Yes. All estimates are free with no obligation.

**Q: How much does chimney repair cost in New Jersey?**
A: Chimney sweeping and inspection typically costs $150–$300. Tuckpointing ranges from $500–$3,000 depending on the extent of mortar deterioration. Crown repair runs $200–$800. Full chimney rebuilds start at $2,500.

**Q: What areas of New Jersey do you serve?**
A: All 21 counties — Bergen, Essex, Middlesex, Monmouth, Morris, Hudson, Union, Ocean, Somerset, Passaic, Camden, Burlington, Mercer, Atlantic, Gloucester, Cumberland, Cape May, Warren, Sussex, Hunterdon, and Salem.

**Q: What handyman jobs can you handle in one visit?**
A: We can tackle multiple jobs in a single visit — drywall patching, painting touch-ups, door adjustments, outlet replacement, faucet repair, furniture assembly, and TV mounting are commonly combined in one appointment.
